## Flowchart 
Always use mermaid syntax to create a flowchart that visualizes the architecture.

## Cross Language Markdown Consistency

- Ensure that the markdown structure and content are consistent across different language versions of the same document.
- Whenever a section or heading is added, removed, or modified in one language version, make the same changes in the corresponding sections of other language versions.

## Markdown Syntax

- Be cautious with special characters in markdown (e.g., underscores, asterisks) to avoid unintended formatting issues.
- Be aware of md conversion tool specific behaviors that may affect how markdown is rendered or interpreted.
